description.value: Reddy Made Cakes is a bakery café in downtown Abbotsford run by Crystal Reddy, who trained at culinary school and worked alongside a French pastry chef before building her business around entirely scratch-made cakes, cupcakes, wedding cakes, and other baked goods. Every component — ganache, fondant, buttercream, preserves — is made in-house using what the business describes as only the best quality ingredients. Cyclists can stop in for walk-in cupcakes and treats, including gluten-free options, or arrange custom pickup orders.
